title: Karl-Witthalm-Straße, Munich
description:
Spacious and light-flooded living pleasure awaits you in this impressive first-time occupancy! With its long south-facing window front, the largest and brightest room in the flat not only offers a great view and plenty of light, but also a pleasant living atmosphere. The entire flat has been completely refurbished and boasts state-of-the-art amenities. With a total of four shared rooms and two bathrooms, it offers an ideal shared layout and the opportunity to spend evenings together in the cooking/dining area or on the communal balcony.

The room is the most spacious in the shared flat at a good 20 square metres and is rented fully furnished with a bed, mattress with topper, wardrobe, armchair, small table, desk, desk chair and a desk lamp and other small details. Of course, you can also bring your own furniture if you wish.

FLAT FURNISHINGS:
- Oak parquet flooring throughout the flat
- Bathroom with bathtub, shower room with rain shower in light grey fine stone
- Electric underfloor heating in both bathrooms
- LAN cabling and multimedia in all rooms
- Electric roller shutters
- Dimmable and controllable recessed LED spotlights in the hallway and kitchen

ROOM SIZES:
- Room 1 (this advert): 20sqm

- Room 2: 15,5sqm
- Room 3: 8,5sqm
- Room 4: 11sqm
- Common area: 28,5sqm



**LOCATION**
The connection to public transport is excellent. Underground, bus and tram stops are just a few minutes' walk away, allowing for smooth and stress-free mobility within the city. At the same time, shopping facilities, restaurants, cafés and other services are within easy walking distance, making everyday life particularly convenient.

UNIVERSITIES (underground connection):
- Haderner Stern - LMU (Campus Großhadern): 3min (without change)
- Haderner Stern - LMU Centre (University): 16min (without change)
- Haderner Stern - TUM (Campus Königsplatz): 19min (1x change)
- Haderner Stern - TUM (Campus Garching Research Centre): 39min (without change)

Due to the proximity to the LMU, students in the shared flat have the luxury of being able to reach their campus by bike in a short time (6 min to Campus Großhadern). This not only saves time and money for the daily commute, but also enables a better work-life balance.

CITY LIFE (bars, shopping, English Garden):

- min. 6 months 
- limited to a maximum of 3 years, but can be optionally extended under certain circumstances 

INCLUDED IN RENT:
- actual basic rent
- all operating costs

- electricity, internet connection

Der Langwieder See und der Lußsee im benachbarten Langwied sind zwei der schönsten Badeseen auf Münchner Stadtgebiet und zudem für ihr sehr sauberes Wasser bekannt. Die nahe gelegene Aubinger Lohe eignet sich für ausgedehnte Spaziergänge.

title: Lochhamer Straße, Planegg
description:
✔️ Fully furnished 18 m2 Standard Apartment — ideal for students & young professionals
✔️ Comfortable box-spring bed (120–160 cm) & private bathroom with shower
✔️ Kitchenette with fridge, stove, microwave & essential kitchenware
✔️ Balcony or terrace, 32" TV, fast WiFi, all utilities included
✔️ Weekly cleaning & linen change; quiet, well-connected location on Lochhamer Str. 6 (Planegg)

This fully furnished Standard Apartment offers an affordable yet comfortable living environment—perfect for students and young professionals who value convenience, privacy and smart use of space. Despite its compact size, the apartment includes everything you need for a pleasant and worry-free stay.

🛋️ The Accommodation
The approx. 18 m2 apartment is cleverly designed to offer maximum comfort. It features a high-quality box-spring bed (120–160 cm), a private bathroom with shower and hairdryer, and a practical kitchenette equipped with a fridge, stove, microwave and basic kitchenware—ideal for preparing simple meals at home.

A 32-inch flat-screen TV with international channels is available for entertainment, and high-speed WiFi is included at no extra cost. The apartment also has either a balcony or terrace, providing additional outdoor space and fresh air.

Weekly cleaning and linen change are included, ensuring a clean and well-maintained living environment without additional effort.

All utilities (heating, electricity, water, WiFi) are included in the rental price, making budgeting easy and transparent.

📍 Location
The apartment is located in a calm and well-connected area at Lochhamer Str., 82152 Planegg, offering excellent access to public transport, shops and everyday amenities. It’s ideal for medium- to long-term stays for anyone working or studying in the Munich area while appreciating a quieter suburban setting.

title: Von-Kahr-Straße, Munich
description:
Die InselMühle liegt im idyllischen Stadtteil München-Untermenzing, direkt am Flusslauf der Würm und eingebettet in ein Landschaftsschutzgebiet. Hier genießen Sie absolute Ruhe und Naturverbundenheit – ohne auf die Vorzüge der Großstadt verzichten zu müssen.

Die Münchner Innenstadt erreichen Sie dank der S-Bahn-Linie S2 in nur wenigen Minuten. Eine Bushaltestelle befindet sich direkt vor dem Haus, sodass Sie bestens an das öffentliche Verkehrsnetz angebunden sind. Mit dem Auto profitieren Sie von einer schnellen Anbindung an die umliegenden Hauptverkehrsstraßen.

In unmittelbarer Umgebung finden Sie grüne Spazierwege, Biergärten und charmante Restaurants. Gleichzeitig sind Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Geschäfte des täglichen Bedarfs sowie Freizeit- und Sportangebote in Kürze erreichbar.

Die Lage verbindet auf einzigartige Weise exklusives Wohnen im Grünen mit urbaner Mobilität – ideal für alle, die sowohl Ruhe als auch Stadtnähe schätzen.

title: Fasanenstraße, Munich
description:
Fully furnished apartment for sublet in November 2025 (1-month) while we are on vacation. No hidden costs! 

Bedroom with 180×200 cm double bed and large wardrobes

Living room with sofa and shelves

Brand-new bathroom (completely renovated in April 2025) with spacious shower

Dining kitchen with all appliances (stove, fridge, oven, microwave) and full kitchenware

Entrance area with large wardrobe

Terrace with garden and outdoor furniture

The bedroom is approx. 13.5 sqm and the living room approx. 25 sqm. Both rooms feature beautiful parquet flooring with underfloor heating and large windows with mosquito screens. Thanks to the ground-floor location and well-insulated windows, the apartment stays pleasantly cool in summer, while the underfloor heating keeps it cozy in winter.

A large wardrobe is located in the bedroom, just to the left of the door.

The kitchen/dining area has a table for up to 6 people with an open kitchen setup. It is especially bright in the mornings and offers a cozy atmosphere in the evenings as well.

The garden and terrace can be accessed through the spacious living room, inviting you to enjoy afternoons and evenings outdoors. The view of the small wooded area from the living room is simply priceless.

The entrance hall provides additional storage space for clothes and shoes.
The bathroom was recently partly renovated and includes both shower and bathtub.
While it has no outside window, it does feature underfloor heating and ventilation like the rest of the apartment.

If needed, an underground parking space is available.

title: Josef-Retzer-Straße, Munich
description:
Die Wohnung ist im Bereich 1.April bis 14.Mai 2026 verfügbar. Mindestmietdauer innerhalb dieses Zeitraumes (egal wann) ist 4 Wochen für 2300 € inkl. NK. Bei vollständiger Vermietung von 1. April bis 14.Mai beträgt die Miete 3000 €. Die Kaution beträgt 2000 €.

Zur befristeten Vermietung steht eine vollständig möblierte, gepflegte 3-Zimmer-Wohnung mit ca. 77 m2 Wohnfläche in ruhiger Lage in München-Pasing.

Die Wohnung befindet sich im 1. Obergeschoss (Dachgeschoss) eines Mehrfamilienhauses (Baujahr 2003) mit Aufzug und Balkon. Sie ist hell und für einen temporären Aufenthalt vollständig ausgestattet. Über dem WohnEssBereich befindet sich ein kleine Galerie.

Der S-Bahnhof München-Pasing mit direkter Anbindung zu Flughafen MUC und Innenstadt 
ist in ca. 13 Gehminuten (ca. 1 km) erreichbar. Dort befindet sich auch das Zentrum von Pasing mit Supermärkten, Viktualienmarkt und Einkaufszentrum. 
Das Westbad (Hallenbad mit Sauna, im Sommer Freibad) liegt ca. 11 Gehminuten, 800 m entfernt.
Im Süden ca. 4 Gehminuten, 300 m, befindet sich ein Grünzug.

Die Lage eignet sich für projektbezogene Aufenthalte / befristete Tätigkeiten und als Urlaubswohnung für 4 Personen (2 Schlafzimmer und 2 Bäder). Die Doppelbetten sind 160 cm breit, auf Wunsch kann in einem der Schlafzimmer das Doppelbett in 2 Einzelbetten geteilt werden bzw entfernt werden
Auf Wunsch kann ein Arbeitsplatz installiert werden im WohnEssBereich, in einem der Schlafzimmer oder auf der Galerie (Tischplatte auf Böcken plus Bürostuhl).

title: Camerloherstraße, Munich
description:
Bright WG Room in Fully Renovated Apartment – Camerloherstraße, Munich

Move into a beautifully renovated apartment (2025) just steps from Laimer Platz U-Bahn station — U5 puts you in the city center in minutes, with additional S-Bahn and tram connections nearby. This fully furnished room comes at an all-inclusive price, so no surprise bills: rent, utilities, and internet all in one simple payment.

The apartment features modern fittings throughout, a shared kitchen and bathroom, and a bright, welcoming atmosphere. Camerloherstraße is a quiet residential street with everyday shops, cafés, and green spaces close by, while still keeping you well connected to the rest of Munich.

Perfect for students or young professionals looking for a comfortable, hassle-free place to call home. Available now - get in touch to arrange a viewing!

title: Radolfzeller Straße, Munich
description:
Fully renovated in 2026, with access to a rooftop terrace complete with swimming pool and sauna.

The apartment has been brought entirely up to date - modern bathroom, new kitchen fittings, fresh flooring and a bright, open feel throughout.

The rooftop is what makes this address special. Swim a few lengths in the pool, unwind in the sauna after work, or simply relax in the sun with a view over the rooftops of Munich.

The location is quietly residential but well connected. The S-Bahn station Westkreuz is 8 minutes on foot, with the S6 and S8 reaching Pasing in a single stop and the city centre shortly after. A Bus stops around the corner and runs directly to Laimer Platz (U5). 

Two supermarkets, a bakery, a bank, a pharmacy and the local library are all within a 1 minute walk, and there is plenty of green space in the surrounding neighbourhood.

Comfortable, modern, and with an amenity you won’t find in most Munich apartments. Available now - get in touch to arrange a viewing.
